analyst.text: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is questionable with a back bruise and neck strain after scoring 40 on Friday, and OKC are already without Caruso, Holmgren, Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace, with a back-to-back in Indiana on Monday. Miami have been off since Wednesday and have won six straight, but Giannis Antetokounmpo is questionable with groin tendinitis. If Shai sits the angle leans clearly towards Miami; if both stars play it is closer.
